permissions: {}

jobs:
  Linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  Windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  macOS:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  FreeBSD:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GRADLE_USER_HOME: ./.gradle-user-home
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Set up Gradle
      uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1
    - name: Run tests in FreeBSD VM
      uses: vmactions/freebsd-vm@c46abacb49f09938ca4e1702d15d836285d694cc # v1.5.9
      with:
        release: "15.0"
        arch: x86_64
        sync: rsync
        copyback: true
        usesh: true
        envs: 'DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY GRADLE_USER_HOME'
        prepare: |
          pkg install -y bash curl git openjdk25 node24 npm-node24
          mount -t procfs proc /proc
        run: |
          pwd
          freebsd-version
          npm i -g corepack --force
          corepack enable npm
          ./gradlew \
          -DRUNNER_TEMP="$(pwd)/.gradle-actions-runner-temp" \
          -Dorg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false \
          -Dorg.gradle.java.installations.paths=/usr/local/openjdk25 \
          -PopenTestReporting.nodeDownload=false \
          --refresh-dependencies \
          javaToolchains \
          build
    - name: Copy captured build results for setup-gradle
      if: ${{ always() }}
      run: |
        if [ -d ./.gradle-actions-runner-temp/.gradle-actions ]; then
          cp -r ./.gradle-actions-runner-temp/.gradle-actions "$RUNNER_TEMP/"
        fi
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
